title: Which JSON content type do I use?
text:
Which JSON content type do I use?

There are many "standards" for the JSON content type:

application/json
application/x-javascript
text/javascript
text/x-javascript
text/x-json

Which one do I use, and where? I assume security and browser support issues are a factor.

Related: What is the MIME type if JSON is being returned by a REST API?
